5. **Whether `.claude/rules/overrides.md` or `.claude/rules/uikit-components.md` exist on `develop`**, and on which other refs they exist.
6. **Any OTHER branch that already contains PDP work** — check `git branch -a` for anything PDP/product related, and for each, one line on what it contains (`git diff --stat origin/develop...<ref> | tail -1` plus the newest commit subject).

@SFCC-89 @pdp
Feature: PDP UI — Static Product Information
  As a shopper browsing the Zimmermann storefront
  I want to see accurate product details when I land on a product page
  So that I can make an informed purchase decision before adding to bag

  Background:
    Given I am on the Zimmermann storefront
    And I navigate to a product detail page for a product with a name, price, description, and style code

  Scenario: Mandatory product fields are displayed on page load
    When the page loads
    Then the product name is displayed prominently at the top of the product information panel
    And the price is displayed beneath the product name in the storefront currency
    And the product description is displayed
    And the product style code is displayed

  Scenario: Model copy is displayed when the SFCC attribute is populated
    Given the product has model copy populated in the relevant SFCC attribute
    When the page loads
    Then the model height and size worn are displayed on the page

  Scenario: Model copy is not shown when the SFCC attribute is not populated
    Given the product does not have model copy populated in the relevant SFCC attribute
    When the page loads
    Then no model copy is displayed
    And no empty placeholder is shown in place of model copy

  Scenario: Breadcrumb reflects the product category path
    When the page loads
    Then a breadcrumb trail is displayed beneath the product images
    And the breadcrumb starts with HOME
    And the breadcrumb reflects the product's category hierarchy

  Scenario: Clicking a breadcrumb node navigates to the category page
    Given the breadcrumb trail is visible on the page
    When the shopper clicks a breadcrumb node
    Then the shopper is navigated to the corresponding category page

  Scenario: Loading state is shown while product data is being fetched
    When the page is loading
    Then skeleton placeholder elements are displayed in place of the product information

  Scenario: Error message is shown when the product cannot be loaded
    Given the product API returns an error
    When the page loads
    Then an error message is displayed in the product information panel
    And no product name, price, description, or style code is shown

  Scenario: Breadcrumb degrades gracefully when the category API fails
    Given the category API returns an error
    When the page loads
    Then only the Home link is shown in the breadcrumb
    And no category nodes are shown

  Scenario: Product name appears as the last breadcrumb item
    When the page loads
    Then the product name is the last item in the breadcrumb trail
    And it is not a clickable link
    And it is marked as the current page for assistive technology

  Scenario: Description is not rendered when absent from the product data
    Given the product has no description in the SFCC data
    When the page loads
    Then no description element is visible on the page

## Inferred (not verified by file content)

- SFCC-91 looks like the **more advanced** PDP line of work in every respect except styling architecture: it reworked the toolbar and breadcrumb, added a real component unit test (`pdpColourSwatches/index.test.tsx`), and wrote a spec doc — but it dropped SFCC-89's theme recipe. A fresh build most likely wants **SFCC-89's `theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts` + SFCC-91's component/toolbar/breadcrumb refinements**, which no single existing branch gives you.
- The `product-detail` squad reassignment in `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs` (B → A) is on both #89 and #91 but not on #55 or develop; it reads like an unratified ownership change riding along on a UI ticket.
- Because #55 is the only branch that creates `ui-kits/`, `static/fonts/`, and `fontFace.tsx`, cutting the new PDP branch *after* #55 merges avoids re-litigating the ui-kit naming convention (camelCase `zimmX/index.tsx`) — the f2r branches use an incompatible kebab-case + `.styles.ts` convention that would otherwise be an open question.
